definitions_frozen_by_the_source_round.all_payable_within_credit: visible >= 2 and payable == visible and sum(charge) <= remaining
definitions_frozen_by_the_source_round.joint_over_credit: visible >= 2 and payable == visible and sum(charge) > remaining (= joint_only_points; a cross-step choice, not a within-step one)
definitions_frozen_by_the_source_round.not_a_competition_point: a single-candidate refusal, and any step counted only because something was refused
definitions_frozen_by_the_source_round.payable: a candidate whose send_executable is true against the credit left when the step opened
definitions_frozen_by_the_source_round.strict_subset_payable: visible >= 2 and 1 <= payable < visible (= budget_competition_points, the only L3 reading)

environment_tripwire.meaning: every episode-running entry point raises EnvironmentCallForbidden instead of running; the log is re-checked at the end of the round and must be empty

A_concurrency_geometry.denominator_note: a step with >= 1 payable candidate is exact for every layer via probe.block_reasons['allowed']; the intersection of 'something payable' and 'something blocked' is derived from block_reasons plus steps_offered, not re-run

none_payable_count.g6_g8_g10: visible >= 1 only (credit_blocked_steps); the >= 2 split is missing

per_step_multi_candidate_count.g6_g8_g10: bounded only: visible_total - steps_offered is an upper bound and (visible_total - steps_offered) / (max_visible - 1) a lower bound, because the delivered rows store sums, not a histogram

B_quote_geometry.per_step_price_min_max_spread: exact for g12 (multi_candidate_prices); for g6/g8/g10 only recoverable at the sampled strict-subset steps
B_quote_geometry.strict_subset_step_candidate_detail: sampled, first 20 steps per cell (COMPETITION_SAMPLE_LIMIT = 20), all four layers
B_quote_geometry.transport_order_effect: readable from the transcripts (send/refusal order), all layers

C_budget_time_structure.credit_fraction_timestamps: exact for all layers: emission_sequence carries per-send cost, so the spend curve is a sum over stored rows

exhaustion_candidate_composition.g6_g8_g10: reconstructed from emission_sequence, then cross-validated against the g12 cells where both are available; the audit reports that agreement rate before trusting the reconstruction

C_budget_time_structure.first_strict_subset_step: exact step number only where the cell has <= 20 points; otherwise the first sampled step is a bound, not the first

D_ledger_only_counterfactual.cannot_claim: task-outcome improvement; holding a refresh changes what the receivers believe, which this round does not model
D_ledger_only_counterfactual.inputs: emission_sequence + refusal_sequence per cell; no environment
D_ledger_only_counterfactual.limitation: the refusal log records the candidates the rule actually attempted and lost, not every visible candidate, so an unblocked message can only be one that was attempted -- this is stated in the verdict, not hidden

status: retrospective mechanism audit; not a pre-registered performance experiment
